Information to build the farm:

(It's F3 + G and not F3 + Q)

The portal cords need to be the same in X,Y and Z cords. 
Summon the wither on top of a stonecutter/chest, a water source block on his head and an obsidian block behind him to block the vision of the wither and the opposite iron-golem).
The nether part is just junk items, you can make a carpet duper…
Loading the Nether is mandatory. Ender Pearl loader should work !

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

!!! This farm can kill you or make your game lag if not built well !!!
